Hi Olivia —

Congrats on getting BrightLeaf set up — I’m Jasmine on the outbound SDR team at Redwood. Our usage alert flagged that your account just crossed a higher-than-expected token threshold (awesome!) and I wanted to offer a quick, focused demo to show a few things that typically help teams when they scale:

- Cost tooling (batching, quantization profiles)
- Model variants & routing to reduce latency/cost
- Dedicated or short-term burst options if you expect traffic spikes

Would you have 20–30 minutes this week for a quick walkthrough? A few slots I have open:
- Tue 6/22: 10:00–10:30am PT or 2:00–2:30pm PT
- Wed 6/23: 9:00–9:30am PT

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time here: https://calendly.com/jasmine-liu/30min

I’m looping in Ben (AE) and Marissa (SDR manager) so we can bring the right technical and commercial context. Quick ask: if you have a specific performance/cost number you want us to focus on, drop it in a reply and we’ll tailor the demo.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Also, is there any pre-read on current cost-savings techniques? If you have a short checklist or one-pager, that would be great.
